tasks.spec:
You are a factory engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model (not `claude`, not `codex`), NEVER use the network, never run `python -m bench run`, never write factory/state/. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff (python files only): `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` / `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 <files>`. Tests must be hermetic (fake runner, no network, no real `claude`). Shared code must stay story-agnostic (no story, scene or character names in production code). If an OLD test pins behaviour this change deliberately changes, update it and say so in NOTES.txt. Write NOTES.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice. Read first: AGENTS.md and docs/contributor-guide.md. FIRST, before anything else, apply the previous round's patch: `git apply /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-32/out/wire-reachability.patch` (it adds the `journey_reachability` gate to factory/stations/free_gates.py and its tests to tests/test_factory_stations.py; the HEAD of this worktree does not have them yet). Then read what it added.

You may edit ONLY: factory/stations/free_gates.py and tests/test_factory_stations.py. Nothing else.

BACKGROUND. The `journey_reachability` gate runs the ~93 s journey suite (about 240 s worst case) and is currently ON for every ticket unless the payload says `journey_reachability: false`. That is wasted time for tickets that touch no story data. Owner decision: run it only for story-data tickets.

CHANGE. Add a helper in free_gates.py (for example `_touches_story_data(payload, repository_root, original_root, tree, story_root) -> bool`) and use it so the gate decision is: (1) payload `journey_reachability` is exactly True -> run; (2) exactly False -> skip; (3) key absent (or any other value) -> run only when the ticket is a story-data ticket. A ticket is a story-data ticket when its payload has a `source_root` key, OR any string entry of its `paths` list, resolved with the existing `_resolve` helper the same way the other gates resolve paths (root `repository_root`, original root only when a ticket tree is in use), lies inside the resolved `story_root` (use the existing `_inside` helper). A malformed `paths` (not a list) or a non-string entry is ignored, never an error. A ticket with no `source_root` and no path under the story root, such as a pure factory/tests ticket, skips the gate. Update the module and handler docstrings accordingly. Keep the gate's position (after the carry matrix, before ruff), command, timeout and failure text unchanged.

TESTS, WRITE THEM FIRST in tests/test_factory_stations.py, extending the journey tests from the previous round: (1) payload with `source_root` and no key runs the gate; (2) payload with only a `paths` entry under the story root runs it (use a tmp story root via the payload's `story_root` key); (3) payload with only paths outside the story root (e.g. factory/foo.py, tests/test_x.py) skips it and the runner sees no journey command; (4) payload with no paths and no source_root skips it; (5) explicit True runs it even for a pure factory ticket; (6) explicit False skips it even for a story-data ticket; (7) with a ticket tree, a path under the tree's story root counts as story data; (8) a non-list `paths` and a non-string entry do not raise. The previous round's tests that relied on the gate being on by default must now either set `journey_reachability: True` or use a story-data payload; keep every assertion and list each changed test in NOTES.txt. Run the whole of tests/test_factory_stations.py and tests/test_factory_checks.py.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-32b
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git reset -q
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^(factory/stations/free_gates\.py|tests/test_factory_stations\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
out=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs -n 4 tests/test_factory_stations.py tests/test_factory_checks.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }
echo "$out" | tail -6
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "tests took $took s (budget 120 s)"
[ "$took" -le 120 ] || { echo "over the 120 s budget"; exit 1; }
case "$out" in *skipped*) echo "tests were skipped"; exit 1;; esac
grep -q 'run-nightly' factory/stations/free_gates.py || { echo "gate command lost"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'source_root' factory/stations/free_gates.py || { echo "source_root rule missing"; exit 1; }
grep -nE "k_sl_|k_scene_|SL-[0-9]|\b[123][A-C]\b" factory/stations/free_gates.py && { echo "story-specific names in production code"; exit 1; } || true
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/reachability-story-data.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/reachability-story-data.patch"
